description: The model id `claude-text` is served by `claude -p` as a tool-less completion. It runs in a fresh empty directory, sends the system prompt as the system prompt, refuses tool definitions, and takes an optional `:<model>` suffix.

specs.description: The bare `claude-text` model id is served by the Claude CLI adapter in text mode with the isolating flags.
specs.given: An inference request whose model id is `claude-text`, with a single user message `hello`.
specs.when: The request is completed.
specs.then: The adapter invokes `claude -p` with `--tools ""`, `--setting-sources ""`, `--strict-mcp-config`, `--disable-slash-commands`, `--no-session-persistence` and `--output-format text`. The completion text returned is the CLI's stdout.

specs.description: An endpoint registered with provider `claude-text` is served the same way.
specs.given: An endpoint registered with provider `claude-text` under some other name.
specs.when: A request is routed to that endpoint.
specs.then: It is served by the Claude CLI adapter in text mode, with the same flags as for model id `claude-text`.

specs.description: The CLI runs in a new empty directory, which is removed afterwards.
specs.given: A `claude-text` request issued from a caller whose working directory contains files.
specs.when: The request is completed successfully.
specs.then: The CLI's working directory is not the caller's directory. It contained no entries when the CLI started. It no longer exists after the call returns.

specs.description: Text mode never passes `--dangerously-skip-permissions`.
specs.given: Any `claude-text` request.
specs.when: The adapter builds the CLI invocation.
specs.then: The argument list does not contain `--dangerously-skip-permissions`.

specs.description: The empty directory is removed even when the CLI fails.
specs.given: A `claude-text` request where the CLI exits non-zero or cannot be spawned.
specs.when: The request is completed.
specs.then: An error is returned and the temporary directory no longer exists.

specs.description: Text mode does not run in the caller's directory.
specs.given: A `claude-text` request issued from a repository directory.
specs.when: The adapter spawns the CLI.
specs.then: The CLI's working directory is neither the caller's directory nor any ancestor or descendant of it.

specs.description: Every `claude-text` invocation is isolated and cleaned up.
specs.given: Any `claude-text` request, with any messages and any `claude-text:<model>` suffix, and any CLI outcome (success, non-zero exit, spawn failure).
specs.when: The request is completed.
specs.then: The invocation carries all six isolating flags. It never carries `--dangerously-skip-permissions`. It ran in a directory that was freshly created and empty at start, and that directory does not exist afterwards.

specs.description: The system prompt and the user message are both delivered.
specs.given: A `claude-text` request with system prompt `You are the spec author.` and user message `Draft ADR-X`.
specs.when: The adapter builds the CLI invocation.
specs.then: `--system-prompt` is passed with value `You are the spec author.`, and the prompt argument contains `Draft ADR-X`.

specs.description: The system prompt is not dropped or folded into the prompt.
specs.given: A `claude-text` request with a system prompt and one user message.
specs.when: The adapter builds the CLI invocation.
specs.then: The system prompt text appears as the value of `--system-prompt`, not only inside the prompt argument. The invocation is not built from the last user message alone.

specs.description: With no system prompt, no `--system-prompt` flag is sent.
specs.given: A `claude-text` request with no system prompt and one user message.
specs.when: The adapter builds the CLI invocation.
specs.then: The argument list does not contain `--system-prompt`, and the prompt carries the user message.

specs.description: A multi-turn conversation is sent as the prompt, not just the last user message.
specs.given: A `claude-text` request with user message `A`, assistant message `B` and user message `C`.
specs.when: The adapter builds the CLI invocation.
specs.then: The prompt argument contains `A`, `B` and `C`.

specs.description: Nothing in the request is lost.
specs.given: Any `claude-text` request with an optional system prompt and one or more conversation messages.
specs.when: The adapter builds the CLI invocation.
specs.then: If a system prompt is present it is the exact value of `--system-prompt`, and every message's content appears in the prompt argument.

specs.description: `claude-text` is not treated as a frontier CLI agent.
specs.given: The model id `claude-text`.
specs.when: `served_by_frontier_cli` is evaluated for it.
specs.then: It returns false.

specs.description: The spec verbs accept `claude-text`.
specs.given: An ADR and the model id `claude-text`.
specs.when: `hexa spec draft <ADR> --model claude-text` or `hexa spec tests <ADR> --model claude-text --crate <dir>` checks the model.
specs.then: The model is not refused under ADR-2610221540 §2.

specs.description: A request carrying tool definitions is refused, and the error names `claude-text`.
specs.given: A `claude-text` request that includes one or more tool definitions.
specs.when: The request is completed.
specs.then: An error is returned whose message contains `claude-text`. The CLI is not invoked, and no completion with the tools silently dropped is returned.

specs.description: Other `claude` ids are still treated as agents.
specs.given: The model id `claude-code`.
specs.when: `served_by_frontier_cli` is evaluated for it.
specs.then: It returns true. Only `claude-text` and `claude-text:<model>` are excluded.

specs.description: No `claude-text` id is an agent, and no tool-carrying request is served.
specs.given: Any model id of the form `claude-text` or `claude-text:<model>`, and any request to it.
specs.when: `served_by_frontier_cli` is evaluated, and the request is completed.
specs.then: `served_by_frontier_cli` is false. Any request with a non-empty set of tool definitions yields an error naming `claude-text`, without invoking the CLI.

specs.description: The suffix after the colon selects the model.
specs.given: A request with model id `claude-text:opus`.
specs.when: The adapter builds the CLI invocation.
specs.then: The argument list contains `--model opus`, and the other text-mode flags are unchanged.

specs.description: Bare `claude-text` passes no `--model`.
specs.given: A request with model id `claude-text`.
specs.when: The adapter builds the CLI invocation.
specs.then: The argument list does not contain `--model`.

specs.description: No concrete Claude model id is hard-coded outside `hexa-infer`.
specs.given: The workspace source outside the `hexa-infer` crate.
specs.when: It is searched for `claude-text:` followed by a model name.
specs.then: No match is found.

specs.description: The model flag is exactly the suffix.
specs.given: Any non-empty string `m`.
specs.when: A request with model id `claude-text:m` is built into a CLI invocation.
specs.then: `--model` appears exactly once, with value `m`.

specs.description: This ADR's tests are recorded red before the adapter exists, then sealed.
specs.given: The hand-written tests for ADR-2610270901, committed before text mode is implemented.
specs.when: They are recorded and `hexa spec seal ADR-2610270901` is run.
specs.then: Each test was recorded failing against the unbuilt adapter, the seal succeeds, and `hexa spec verify ADR-2610270901` checks those sealed tests.

specs.description: The bootstrap exception is not available to other ADRs.
specs.given: Any ADR other than ADR-2610270901 whose spec or tests were produced outside `hexa spec draft` or `hexa spec tests`.
specs.when: `hexa spec verify` is run for that ADR.
specs.then: The ADR does not pass on the strength of the ADR-2610270901 exception; the normal gate applies.
